findings.description: Loop handlers read .first() without runIndex. Replaying the first prepared state for the next response loses the lookup phase. n8n run-state behavior requires validation before activation.
Empty access settings accept any chat/user. Production access must be explicitly configured.
Assignee, deadline and priority are included in the description; native YouGile fields are not assigned.

limitations: No live Telegram, LLM or YouGile integration run
Original setup guide contains residual private infrastructure names and is not republished
